label: Participated or extended eternity: The q.10 a.3 uses of eternity for never ceasing, long duration…
definition: The q.10 a.3 uses of eternity for never ceasing, long duration, or stable being/operation derived from God; these are distinguished from proper divine eternity.
note: Owner-selected declaration completion (2026-11-09), with attribution deferred for the formal interpretation: ONE disjunctive extended sense, not three new senses or three jointly necessary requirements. Extended p is NeverCeasing p.present OR (nonempty presence AND contextualStandard < duration) OR (nonempty presence AND there exists the SAME Aspect, being or operation, with stable aspect AND receivedFromGod aspect). NeverCeasing reuses FutureUnending (nonempty presence, a later present moment after each present moment) and requires persistence at every later admitted moment; it permits a beginning and excludes a gappy future presence. The temporal preorder, presence interpretation, duration magnitude and its strict contextual comparison are supplied framework inputs; no quantitative physical clock or universal long-duration threshold is asserted. The duration and contextualStandard fields are primitives on a supplied scale, not a derived measure of motion. The stable and receivedFromGod predicates are explicit primitives: stable means stable being or stable operation, respectively; receipt is receipt of that same aspect from God, not merely causation by an unspecified being. No transitivity, asymmetry, conservation law, source authenticity or real-world applicability is inferred. Illustrative interpretations are a never-ceasing life, a finite duration long relative to its context, or a creature with stable operation received from God; these are examples of use, not newly sourced claims. Short finite duration lacking both stability and receipt is a non-example. No identity with proper eternity, full perfect possession, BoethianEternal, time as measure of motion or aevum as measure of substantial being is asserted. Actual applicability and the recognition/calibration of proper Eternal remain OPEN. branchControls, omissions, emptyFails and properRecognitionNotForced check the three independent alternatives, same-aspect receipt, stability/receipt/threshold omissions, nonvacuity and absent proper-eternity recognition. Neither stable alone nor receivedFromGod alone suffices in a short finite profile.
